questions.question: What literary form is Ezekiel 19?
options: A proverb about the way of the wise
A psalm of praise for God's deliverance
A lamentation for the princes of Israel
A genealogy of the kings of Judah
questions.answer: A lamentation for the princes of Israel

questions.question: What two images does the lament use?
options: A soaring eagle and a tall cedar tree
A lioness with her cubs and a fruitful vine
A flowing river and a fig tree in bloom
A faithful shepherd and his scattered sheep
questions.answer: A lioness with her cubs and a fruitful vine

questions.question: The lament describes the vine being plucked up in fury and planted in a dry land.
What was your mother? A _____ among lions!
This is a lament and shall be used as a _____.
